meta.name: goofish-search-list
meta.description: Scrapes second-hand item search results from Goofish (闲鱼/xianyu, goofish.com) — China's largest second-hand marketplace. Input: keyword, optional sort/filter params. Output: list of items with id, title, price, image, location, want-count per page (30 items/page). Use when user mentions goofish, 闲鱼, xianyu, 二手交易, second-hand marketplace China, 二手商品搜索, search used goods, scrape goofish listings, xianyu search results, collect second-hand prices, monitor used item prices, 闲鱼关键词搜索, 闲鱼数据采集, 批量抓取闲鱼, goofish scraper, goofish data, xianyu data extraction, 二手商品价格监控, used iPhone prices, 二手手机价格. Also applies to: price research on Chinese second-hand market, competitor product monitoring via used goods listings, inventory analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索闲鱼二手商品并获取列表信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从闲鱼批量获取二手商品数据。
copy.tagline_en: Search second-hand items on Goofish and get listing details.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch fetch second-hand product data from Goofish.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你从闲鱼搜索二手商品，返回每页最多30条结果，包含商品ID、标题、价格、图片、所在地和想要人数。
howto.when: 当你提到闲鱼、xianyu、二手交易、二手商品搜索、闲鱼关键词搜索、闲鱼数据采集等关键词，或要求搜索二手商品、监控二手价格时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下闲鱼上iPhone 14的价格。
say.note: Claude 会打开闲鱼搜索页面并提取结果列表。

say.text: 在闲鱼上搜索二手相机，按价格从低到高排序。
say.note: Claude 会应用排序并返回结果。

say.text: 抓取闲鱼上“二手手机”前两页的数据。
say.note: Claude 会翻页并提取多页商品信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search for second-hand items on Goofish (xianyu) and return up to 30 results per page, including item ID, title, price, image, location, and want-count.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention goofish, xianyu, 闲鱼, second-hand marketplace, search used goods, scrape goofish listings, or similar keywords related to Goofish search and data extraction.

say_en.text: Search for iPhone 14 prices on Goofish.
say_en.note: Claude will open the search page and extract results.

say_en.text: Search for used cameras on Goofish, sorted by price low to high.
say_en.note: Claude will apply sorting and return results.

say_en.text: Scrape the first two pages of 'used phones' on Goofish.
say_en.note: Claude will paginate and extract multiple pages.
